name: VC Dimension of the Odd-Torsion Dual Class
proof: Every coordinate has exactly three positive concepts. A shattered triple of coordinates would require four distinct concepts positive on its first coordinate, so VC is at most two. The missing-triple coordinates $\{0,1,2\}$ and $\{0,2,4\}$ are shattered: vertices zero, one, four and three realize the pairs $(1,1),(1,0),(0,1),(0,0)$, respectively.
references: Direct shattering argument; the deterministic construction verifier checks the two coordinates.
